mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_like (board_id, post_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{board_id}, #{post_id}, #{user_id}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_like WHERE board_id = #{board_id} AND post_id = #{post_id} AND user_id = #{user_id}
mapper.select: SELECT board_id, post_id, user_id, created_at FROM post_like WHERE board_id = #{board_id} AND post_id = #{post_id} ORDER BY created_at DESC
